commands: for w in chat code ptime mixed agent; do CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<gpu> python spikes/x0_offload/m6/capture.py --model <Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf> --workload $w --out local/tmp/x0-m6/$w.npz; done
python spikes/x0_offload/m6/replay.py --traces local/tmp/x0-m6 --gguf <gguf> --train agent --test chat code mixed --out local/tmp/x0-m6/replay_rev.json
rates_note: PCIe 25/50 GB/s, GPU 900 GB/s and SSD 7 GB/s are placeholders until M1/M3 land; the A5000 prefill times stand in for the bar card's

rates_placeholder.note: placeholders until M1 (PCIe) and M3 land; GPU ≈ the RTX 5080
placeholders until M1 (PCIe) and M3 land; GPU ≈ the RTX 5080

profile_decay_lag_check.metric: hit_rate, ms_per_token pcie25, ms_per_token pcie25 admission hidden

prefetch_model_agent_lfu.method: idealized: prefetch layer l+1's top-12 non-resident predictions fully overlapped with compute; per token max(PCIe bytes / rate, GPU bytes / 900 GB/s) with PCIe bytes = covered misses + unused prefetches + uncovered misses

decision.default_policy: lfu (least modelled time in 26 of 30 held-out cells; lru wins 4 at 10% cached by <= 0.6% and is within 7% everywhere)

knobs.admission: in place on the fetch path when the miss's count beats the coldest resident not needed this step
knobs.warm_start: profile, 4 slots per layer then the global ranking

decision.d8: routed-only staging below ~256 tokens, stream from ~1K tokens (256 flips with the PCIe rate); re-derive with M1 and the 5080's layer time
decision.d11: recall trigger met at top-12 (94.5-96.3%), borderline at top-8 (84.3-87.2%); the replay's model shows a loss except at 50 GB/s and 47% cached (~9%): keep D11, re-check with M1
